title: QACD risk request
description: Request body for POST /v1/qacd/risk. Field names and semantics are frozen; new fields may only be added, never repurposed.

answer.description: Frozen LVLM answer to be scored.

image.description: Image path, URL or opaque identifier.

threshold.description: Overrides the frozen warning threshold. Affects is_high_risk only, never risk_score.

return_claims.description: Include per-claim risk detail in the response.
